dedupe_keys.name: basel convention national reporting data on generation and transboundary movements of hazardous wastes

description: Parties to the Basel Convention report every year how much hazardous and other waste they generate and how much they export and import, and to which countries. The Secretariat's data visualisation tool presents these national reports interactively: generation by waste category, and exports and imports between country pairs, together with notifications of national hazardous waste definitions and import or export bans. The producer is the Secretariat of the Basel, Rotterdam and Stockholm Conventions, hosted by the United Nations Environment Programme, compiling reports submitted by Parties. Coverage is the Parties to the Convention, for reporting years 2006 to 2010 in the tool. It is free to use online under the Secretariat's website terms; no open licence or bulk download is offered in the tool. Caveats: reporting is incomplete and inconsistent between Parties, exporter and importer figures often disagree, the tool stops at 2010 and was built for older browsers, and later years must be read from individual national reports. Simulation uses: bilateral flows of hazardous waste for network models of waste trade and treatment capacity dependence, and for scenarios of border closures or export bans. Related records: Eurostat municipal waste statistics (data-eurostat-env-wasmun) give European treatment routes.
